specName: A Build Workflow and Status Badge for Every Repository

FR-001.title: Every repository has exactly one designated build workflow, same name everywhere

FR-002.title: Build workflow runs on PRs into develop, new PR commits, and changes to develop

FR-003.title: Result shown on the PR; a failure names the step and links its output

FR-004.title: Workflow checks what the repository holds (schemas, host build and tests, site checks, files)

FR-005.title: Maintainer can re-run the workflow without pushing

FR-006.title: Fork PRs get no secrets; nothing is published from a PR run

FR-007.title: Every job runs on the runner chosen by one repo-level switch, hosted when unset

FR-008.title: Every repository readme shows its build badge for develop, linked to its runs

FR-009.title: etalii.adp, vscode and eclipse gain a readme with name, purpose and badge

FR-010.title: Both build tables list every repository exactly once

FR-011.title: Public repository rows show the same badge and link as the readme

FR-012.title: Private repository rows show a plain-text not-public note, no broken image

FR-014.title: Renaming a repository or workflow updates every badge and row in the same change

FR-015.title: docs/new-repository.md requires workflow, readme badge and both table rows

FR-016.title: Constitution no longer says there is no CI workflow

context: area: all seven etalii-adp repositories (.github/workflows, readmes)
area: etalii.adp.site home page build table
reference: RUNS_ON switch from standalone PR 93 and site PR 13
constraint: constitution requires CI to validate every example against its schema
intent: Every etalii-adp repository runs one build workflow on PRs and develop, with its badge in its readme and in both org-wide build tables
